course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A software company has recorded the time (in minutes) taken by developers to solve a (14) [CO4] single coding problem based on their levels of experience:

content.value_html:
Experience LevelTime Taken to Solve Problem (minutes)
Junior Developers35, 40, 45, 70, 100, 75, 55, 50, 65, 60
Mid-Level Developers90, 40, 30, 35, 25, 55, 50, 60, 65, 45
Senior Developers15,25,20,35,30,40,55,50,45,95

content.value: i) Create a boxplot for each experience level based on the time taken to solve the problem. Show median, quartiles, IQR, and outliers.
ii) Compare the boxplots by skewness, spread, and median. Discuss which group performs better and how experience impacts problem-solving time.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
